headline: Russia Launches Massive Ukraine Barrage as Iran Drones Strike Kuwaiti US Bases
subheadline: IDF targets Hamas tunnels beyond Gaza Yellow Line as Russian missiles hit Kyiv and Iranian drones strike Kuwaiti air bases.
lede: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across Ukraine using Geran-5 missiles, Shahed UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles, striking Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Vinnytsia with hits on civilian infrastructure and a Kremenchuk oil refinery. Ukrainian forces damaged the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai, struck a Siverskyi Donets logistics bridge near Stanitsia Luhanska, and hit a repair base in Kursk region. In the Middle East, Israeli forces began a ground operation beyond Gaza's Yellow Line targeting Hamas tunnel infrastructure in Bureij and Nuseirat, while Iranian drones struck Al-Jahra and Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait and Bahrain issued aerial attack alerts. The US confirmed foiled Iranian assassination plots and Gulf states urged the Trump administration not to attack Iran.

sections.title: Russia Barrages Ukraine; Kyiv Strikes Russian Refineries
sections.body: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile attack across Ukraine, deploying Geran-5 missiles, Shahed UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles against Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, and other regions. Strikes hit civilian infrastructure in Kyiv and an oil refinery in Kremenchuk, while Russian attacks on Odesa's historic center killed four and injured nine civilians on 18 November. Ukrainian forces damaged the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai and struck a logistics bridge over the Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska plus a repair base in Kursk region. Poland foiled a Russian sabotage operation on the Kaliningrad border intended to cause mass casualties and frame Ukraine.

sections.title: IDF Ground Operation in Central Gaza
sections.body: Israeli forces launched a ground operation in central Gaza beyond the Yellow Line targeting Hamas tunnel infrastructure in Bureij and Nuseirat, displacing civilians and closing the Salah a-Din road. The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed activity to destroy a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line in the Nuseirat area. Iranian-backed drones targeted Al-Jahra and Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait, while Bahrain announced continued hostile Iranian attacks and issued alerts for possible aerial strikes. The US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert for Americans, and Gulf states urged the Trump administration not to attack Iran fearing retaliatory strikes.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran is escalating asymmetric pressure across the Gulf through drone strikes on Kuwaiti bases hosting US assets, direct threats to Bahrain, and confirmed foiled assassination plots. Israel faces a dual challenge with a renewed central Gaza ground operation targeting Hamas tunnels and northern escalation signals from Lebanon artillery fire and IAF sorties. The convergence of Iranian regional aggression and Israeli military recalibration, including reduced battalion deployments and reserve duty, creates a volatile environment where miscalculation could trigger wider conflict.
